u1.title: Grammar focus · Future simple and future continuous

data.问题: Complete (future simple): One day, humans ___ (live) on Mars.
data.答案: will live

data.问题: Complete (future continuous): At this time tomorrow, we ___ (travel) to Mars.
data.答案: will be travelling

data.问题: Difference: 'I will eat at 7' vs 'I will be eating at 7.'
data.答案: Simple: at 7 I'll start. Continuous: the action will be in progress at 7.

data.问题: When do we use future continuous?
data.答案: For an action that will be in progress at a specific future time.

u1.title: More reading · Why bother with Mars?

data.问题: What is the first reason to explore Mars?
data.答案: Mars teaches us how to live with fewer resources.

data.问题: What is the second reason?
data.答案: It drives new technology that also helps Earth.

data.问题: What is the third reason?
data.答案: It gives humanity a backup plan for survival.

data.问题: What is the author's purpose in this passage?
data.答案: To argue that Mars exploration is valuable for humanity's future.

u2.title: Reading · A letter from Helen Keller

data.问题: At what age did Helen Keller lose her sight and hearing?
data.答案: Only 19 months old.

data.问题: Who helped Helen learn to communicate?
data.答案: Her teacher, Anne Sullivan.

data.问题: What was Helen's message to young readers?
data.答案: Never give up; the best things in life cannot be seen or touched — they are felt with the heart.

data.问题: What can you infer about Helen's character?
data.答案: She was incredibly determined, optimistic and resilient.

u2.title: Reading · A letter from Helen Keller

data.问题: Helen lost her sight and hearing at ___ months.

data.问题: The letter's tone is ___.
data.答案: B

u2.title: More reading · Ordinary heroes in our own streets

data.答案: A teacher who stays late to help students; a neighbour who volunteers every weekend.

data.问题: What is the author's purpose?
data.答案: To redefine 'greatness' — it's found in everyday acts of kindness and courage.

data.答案: It is the largest continent with incredible diversity — ancient temples and modern wonders.

data.问题: What can we infer about Asia's appeal to travellers?
data.答案: Its mix of ancient history and modern development makes it uniquely attractive.

data.问题: The journey lasts ___ days.
data.答案: B

data.问题: The first stop is in ___.

u3.title: Grammar focus · Comparatives and superlatives (review + long adjectives)

data.答案: more comfortable

data.问题: What is the rule for long adjectives?

u6.title: Grammar focus · Linking words: however, therefore, although, because

data.问题: Join: She felt nervous. She smiled bravely. (however)
data.答案: She felt nervous; however, she smiled bravely.

data.问题: Join: He was late. He missed the first show. (therefore)
data.答案: He was late; therefore, he missed the first show.

data.问题: Join: She was tired. She kept working. (although)
data.答案: Although she was tired, she kept working.

data.问题: What does 'therefore' express?
data.答案: A result or logical conclusion.
